summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType and Tuple[ControlType, str] to the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" formatting entry and Control.title(title) classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor, returning True when is_terminal and buffering the control, otherwise False; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch calling term.set_title(control_code[1]); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (console, skipped on Windows), test_control_title (control), test_control_set_window_title (Windows renderer, mocked). Not run: per instructions, tests and Black were not executed, so results and formatting are unverified. Nothing committed. Assumed PR link format https://github.com/Textualize/rich/pull/2200.
